BUILDING CONSTRUCTION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: BUILDING CONSTRUCTION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Domestic Water Supply, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Domestic Water Supply.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Domestic Water Supply.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Domestic Water Supply.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Domestic Water Supply.

2. When learning Site Organisation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Site Organisation.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Site Organisation.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Site Organisation.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Site Organisation.

3. When learning Doors, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Doors.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Doors.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Doors.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Doors.

4. When learning Construction Hand Power Tools, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Construction Hand Power Tools.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Construction Hand Power Tools.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Construction Hand Power Tools.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Construction Hand Power Tools.

5. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. CPU
   C. Speaker
   D. Monitor

6. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Information and Communication Technology
   B. International Cricket Team
   C. Input Cable Tester
   D. Internal Cooking Timer

7. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Remove all guards
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

8. When learning Sanitary Appliances, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Sanitary Appliances.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Sanitary Appliances.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Sanitary Appliances.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Sanitary Appliances.

9. When learning Windows, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Windows.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Windows.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Windows.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Windows.

10. When learning Scaffolding, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Scaffolding.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Scaffolding.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Scaffolding.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Scaffolding.

11. When learning Roof Construction, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Roof Construction.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Roof Construction.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Roof Construction.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Roof Construction.

12. When learning Orthographic Projection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Orthographic Projection.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Orthographic Projection.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Orthographic Projection.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Orthographic Projection.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Building Construction Project and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Construction Hand Power Tools and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Construction Plant and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Site Organisation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
